name: view-stack
title: View stack
description: Push and pop views inside one panel, like a phone settings app: titles, a Back button, a slide and a height that follows, in a popover, sheet or card.
docs: Pass views, a registry by id ({ settings: { title, content }, email: { … } }); the first is the root. defaultStack (ids, root first) or stack with onStackChange(stack) controls which are open. Each view has a heading; a view above another shows a Back button named after the title it returns to (labels.back, Back to {title}). A pushed view slides in from the side and the one below slides away, or they cross-fade under reduced motion; focus moves to the new heading, and on Back it returns to the row that opened the view. Views below the top stay mounted but are inert, so Tab and a screen reader only meet the one on top, and a form in them keeps what was typed. The height of the stack follows the view on top with a transition, so a popover or sheet resizes smoothly; give the stack a max-height class and a long view scrolls inside it with its header kept in place. Views push and pop with useViewStack(), which returns { stack, current, push(id, opener), pop(count), reset() }, or with ViewStackRow, a row with an icon, a name, what is set today and a chevron. headingLevel (2, 3 or 4) fits the headings to the page. The stack takes its background from its container (bg-inherit), so put a background on the popover, card or sheet around it.
